question: Bone is an example of which of the following types of tissues?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Connective tissue'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Bone is a type of **specialized connective tissue.**
 
• Connective tissues are specialized to connect and anchor Bones.
 
• They give support to various parts of **creating packaging** around the organs.
 
• The tissue is composed of a gel-like intercellular substance called **medium or matrix**, which forms the main bulk.
 
• Bones is a **porous, highly vascular, mineralized, hard, and rigid.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Muscular tissue: **The muscular system is composed of specialized cells called **muscle fibers.** Their predominant function is contractibility.
 
• **Epithelial tissue: **The epithelium is a type of body tissue that forms the covering on all internal and external surfaces of your body, lines cavities, and hollow organs and is the major issue in glands.
 
• **Nervous tissue:** Nervous or nerve tissue is the main tissue of our** nervous system.** It monitors and regulates the functions of the body.
